snippet.title: Urban Jungle - Nintendo Switch Release Trailer
snippet.description:
🌵Out Now: https://www.nintendo.com/en-gb/Games/Nintendo-Switch-download-software/Urban-Jungle-3112056.html?srsltid=AfmBOorl_ybczdvAKv9Mh6Rd9iLs0Cooqro0LQm6ciyjP-8IWdFaZB8w
Use luscious plants to turn your ordinary home into a green haven in Urban Jungle. Find the best place for each plant in your small apartment and enjoy gardening without worries. And don't forget to pet your cat!

Assemble Entertainment is an independent publisher based in Germany, best known for indie hits such as Sticky Business, Roadwarden, Decktamer, Paddle Paddle Paddle, Grind Survivors and the Endzone franchise. Since 2016, Assemble has released more than 50 games across different genres, including cozy, horror, strategy and roguelike, and has established itself as a trusted partner for bringing original indie projects to market.
